label: BPSK / QPSK synchronized receiver
about: Configure the waveform family, symbol rate and known preamble. Acquisition estimates carrier, fractional symbol timing and clock rate; training-only LS channel and FFE are checked on held-out training. Payload phase/timing loops never use supplied data references. Natural phase indices, MSB first; unchecked bytes remain candidates. Select a contiguous burst with pulse and equalizer guards. CFO acquisition is ambiguous outside ± input rate / (2 × constellation order).
data_reference: Known payload phase indices / EVM only (empty: decision reference)
maximum_holdout_evm: Maximum held-out training RMS error / ratio
issue.parameter: The value is outside its declared type or range.
issue.symbols: Training or reference indices do not match the configured constellation.
issue.configuration: Use 2–64 input samples per symbol, an adequate preamble, odd tap counts and a complete or empty data reference.
issue.erasure: Unknown, partial or unreliable point; not a recovered byte.
sync.short: Insufficient contiguous observations including pulse/equalizer guards.
sync.ambiguous: Preamble lock is weak or ambiguous; data EVM is unavailable.
sync.holdout: Equalizer failed independent training hold-out; data EVM is unavailable.
evm.unavailable: EVM requires synchronization and at least eight valid data points.
stage.decisions: Natural symbol decisions and MSB byte packing
sequence.observed: Matched-filter observations and causal tracking support
frame.scope: No application checksum or device identity established. Decision-reference EVM does not measure bit error rate.
metric.evm_rms: Data EVM RMS / average reference power
metric.evm_peak: Data EVM peak / average reference power
metric.evm_rms.known: Data EVM RMS / known data reference
